precepts.text: All this have I spoken before thee, O Lord, because thou madest the world for our sakes. For whose sake? Our sake. The enemy knows that. Esau knows that the world was made for our sake. So they have to create laws to remove us, to set puppet presidents up, and pass laws against us. What they do now is they give visas to Israeli nationals. They come to our lands and they buy up property. We see that. When we go to Ecuador, when we go to Peru, Guatemala, you see them coming into the lands, they get free visas, and they are allowed to buy property, whereas the people of the land have to jump through hoops and hurdles just to maintain the lot that they have.
precepts.point: Even a man and his heritage. Remember, these lands were given to us by God.

note.label: Abya Yala Under Fire

precepts.why:
Micah says, “they covet fields, and take them by violence; and houses, and take them away: so they oppress a man and his house, even a man and his heritage.” Even a man and his heritage: these lands were given to us by God. Ezra says why: “All this have I spoken before thee, O Lord, because thou madest the world for our sakes”.

For whose sake? Our sake. Not everybody's sake: our sake. The enemy knows that. Esau knows that the world was made for our sake, so he has to create laws to remove us, set puppet presidents up, and pass laws against us.

That is how they covet the fields. They want our lands; they want to be the landlords. They take them by any means necessary: by fires, by earthquakes, by murder, deception, creating laws and setting up puppet presidents. They take our houses, and that is why we migrate and get displaced: our lands are burned and destroyed and taken from us for the precious resources, the minerals underneath. So they oppress an Israelite man and his house, where he is from and where he lives.

Now they give visas to Israeli nationals, who come to our lands and buy up property. When we go to Ecuador, Peru and Guatemala, you see them coming in on free visas, allowed to buy property, while the people of the land have to jump through hoops and hurdles just to keep the lot they have. In Argentina the laws were changed so that foreigners could buy land, and the state of Israel is buying up land at cheap prices. It is the heritage God gave us, and the world made for our sakes, that they are after.

precepts.text: Wherefore thus saith the Holy One of Israel, Because ye despise this word, and trust in oppression and perverseness, and stay thereon: therefore this iniquity shall be to you as a breach ready to fall, swelling out in a high wall, whose breaking cometh suddenly at an instant. Because we despise God's word and trust in oppression. It was a sin for us to trust in this oppression and to stay and believe in it. There is no comfort, no protective covering, in this society, in us assimilating into America, Babylon the great.
precepts.point: Even with a sore destruction. That is where we are right now as a nation of people. Just go on social media and look at how we think as a people, at all these opinionated podcasts, because you can go on Amazon and get a thirty dollar kit and now it is exposing what is actually in our people's minds. And you can see we are in a sore destruction as a nation, from the aged man and the aged woman down to the children, because we have gotten comfortable in our captivity and forgotten our homeland. We do not even want to go back to it any more.

note.label: Give Diligence

precepts.why:
Micah says, “Arise ye, and depart; for this is not your rest: because it is polluted, it shall destroy you, even with a sore destruction.” America, Babylon the great, all the lands we have been enslaved and colonised in, are not our rest. Isaiah shows why staying in them destroys us: “Wherefore thus saith the Holy One of Israel, Because ye despise this word, and trust in oppression and perverseness, and stay thereon”.

We despise God's word and trust in oppression. It was a sin for us to trust in this oppression and to stay and believe in it. “Therefore this iniquity shall be to you as a breach ready to fall, swelling out in a high wall, whose breaking cometh suddenly at an instant.” There is no comfort and no protective covering in this society, in assimilating into America, Babylon the great. Our brothers and sisters that love this society and this world, it is our downfall as a people.

That is the pollution Micah speaks of. When you forget where you come from and get comfortable in the land of your captivity, it destroys you, because you begin to take on the attributes of your oppressor. That is not for us. We are God's children, and trying to make the oppressor's ways work for us always backfires. The white man has had the sword and the power to rule the world, but God will not let his children follow after him like the rest of the world and prosper.

So the wall breaks suddenly. In every place we have been, oppression, death and destruction follow behind us, and there is no peace there. Look at the families of Nolan Wales, of Kendrick Johnson, of the young woman found hanging from a tree in Mississippi: they never have rest again. And look at how we think as a people on social media and in all these podcasts: from the aged man and aged woman down to the children, we are in a sore destruction, because we have gotten comfortable in our captivity, “forgotten their restingplace”, and do not even want to go back to our homeland.

precepts.text: If a man walking in the spirit and falsehood do lie, saying, I will prophesy unto thee of wine and of strong drink; he shall even be the prophet of this people. If you following them doctrines, them philosophies, them lies, that man going to be the prophet to you, a prophet to lead you right to hell. A lot of these wicked pastors just chasing money and don't care about the people's souls, about healing the people and bringing them back to Christ.
precepts.point: We got the power to bring our people back to God, and we refuse to do it because we selfish, greedy, covetous, and we love preeminence in this place. This place taught us how to go against our God, but we teaching our people how to come back to him in righteousness. It's going to be a great fight, but this fight going to be won.

note.label: Awake and Return: Overcoming Babylon's Hypnosis

precepts.why:
“Therefore hear now this, thou afflicted, and drunken, but not with wine.” We are an afflicted people, and we haven’t realized it yet. We are being put through the wringer because we constantly break his law of commandments, because we departed from God, because we don’t know who we are, and because God has been calling us and we refuse to turn around and come back to him. And we are drunken, but not with wine. Drunken with what? Micah shows it.

“If a man walking in the spirit and falsehood do lie, saying, I will prophesy unto thee of wine and of strong drink; he shall even be the prophet of this people.” We are drunk with philosophy and doctrines, the lies we learned here in America. If you follow those doctrines, those laws, those philosophies, those lies, that man is going to be the prophet to you: a prophet to lead you right to hell.

A lot of these wicked and evil pastors are just chasing money, money, money, and don’t give a damn about the people’s souls or their spirits. They don’t care about healing the people, fixing the people and bringing them back to Christ. The people are crying, looking for Christ, and these men mislead them while chasing the dollar bill. Let those men be your prophet if you are going to believe that garbage.

That is why we have gangs in the street, prostitutes in the street, our sons fainted and lying “at the head of all the streets, as a wild bull in a net”: the dead Israelites in the churches are not teaching our people how to keep the Lord’s commandments or how to come back to Christ. But the Lord who “pleadeth the cause of his people” says he has taken the cup of trembling out of our hand, and “I will put it into the hand of them that afflict thee.”

precepts.text: If a man walking in the spirit and falsehood do lie, saying, I will prophesy unto thee of wine and of strong drink; he shall even be the prophet of this people. Wine there symbolizes lies: that is what our people are drunk with.
precepts.point: And thou hast laid thy body as the ground: our people will weep publicly for men who never said or did anything for them, but will not cry for each other. That is Isaiah 51:23 in action.

note.label: Job Sees America's 250th Anniversary

precepts.why:
“Therefore hear now this, thou afflicted, and drunken, but not with wine”. We are an afflicted people: look at the news, and we are afflicted from sun up to sun down, over and over. You can turn a blind eye to it, but it's there. And we are a drunk people. What does it mean we're drunk? We're drunk with lies, drunk with religions, drunk with falsehood.

Micah shows that wine represents falsehood: “If a man walking in the spirit and falsehood do lie, saying, I will prophesy unto thee of wine and of strong drink; he shall even be the prophet of this people.” Wine and strong drink symbolize lies. The man walking in falsehood prophesies lies, and he becomes the prophet of this people.

So what are we drunk with? Lies. Some of us believe in these false Christian religions, Islam, politics; we're drunk in some philosophy out here. But the Lord “pleadeth the cause of his people”, and he says “I have taken out of thine hand the cup of trembling”. That is why we are waking up now. “even the dregs of the cup of my fury”: the dregs is the bottom, the last few drops left in the cup. “thou shalt no more drink it again” after this captivity is over. He will put it into the hand of them that afflict us, Esau and the nations.

precepts.text: If a man walking in the spirit and falsehood do lie, saying, I will prophesy unto thee of wine and of strong drink; he shall even be the prophet of this people. The wine and strong drink are the lies. That is what Isaiah 28 is talking about.
precepts.point: Isaiah is prophesying against the rulers of his time. They have erred through wine, and through strong drink are out of the way: the priest and the prophet have erred through strong drink, they err in vision, they stumble in judgment. This is not about them literally getting drunk; the wine and strong drink are the falsehoods and lies, the doctrines they push.

note.label: Traitors and Their Exquisite Subtlety: The Judas Iscariot Effect

precepts.why:
Isaiah prophesies against the elders and rulers of his time: “they also have erred through wine, and through strong drink are out of the way; the priest and the prophet have erred through strong drink, they are swallowed up of wine.” People read that and think these men were getting drunk. That is not what it is talking about. Micah shows what the wine is.

“If a man walking in the spirit and falsehood do lie, saying, I will prophesy unto thee of wine and of strong drink; he shall even be the prophet of this people.” The wine and strong drink are the falsehoods and the lies. It is not the priests and prophets actually getting drunk and teaching; it is them pushing doctrines.

Read Isaiah again with that: they have erred through doctrine, lies and falsehoods, and are out of the way of the Lord. “they err in vision, they stumble in judgment”: they do not teach correctly; it is their erroneous doctrine. “For all tables are full of vomit and filthiness, so that there is no place clean.”

So if the priests and prophets are that wicked, whom will God teach knowledge? “them that are weaned from the milk, and drawn from the breasts”: those raised on the word of God, the Old and New Testament, who learn it “precept must be upon precept”, “line upon line”, “here a little, and there a little”, not by commentary and the doctrine of the oppressor.

And that same strong drink is the refuge of the rulers in verse 15: “we have made lies our refuge, and under falsehood have we hid ourselves.” I teach everybody can be saved, I teach he is not Esau, the white man will protect me, the scourge will pass me by. Micah’s prophet of wine and strong drink is exactly the prophet this people wants.

precepts.text: I will surely assemble, O Jacob, all of thee: all twelve tribes. I will put them together as the sheep of Bozrah, as the flock in the midst of their fold. The same thing Christ was saying: them also I must bring, that there may be one fold and one shepherd.
precepts.point: For all of us, there was a time that we heard this voice. We heard the word of God and it triggered us to repentance, to change. Something innate in us made us acknowledge the word of God by hearing his voice and changing our life.

note.label: Acts 10 Reloaded: Call No Man Common

precepts.why:
Christ said, “there shall be one fold, and one shepherd.” The fold he was speaking in was the Jews in Jerusalem, primarily Judah, Benjamin and Levi. The other sheep, not of that fold, were the rest of Israel, and he would gather the two nations, the southern and northern kingdoms, together under one shepherd, Jesus Christ.

Micah prophesied that one fold: “I will surely assemble, O Jacob, all of thee; I will surely gather the remnant of Israel; I will put them together as the sheep of Bozrah, as the flock in the midst of their fold: they shall make great noise by reason of the multitude of men.”

“all of thee” means all twelve tribes. That is the same thing Christ was saying: I have sheep that are not of this fold; them also I must bring, that there may be one fold and one shepherd. The prophecy was that all twelve tribes were going to be brought back together.

The beginning of it coming to fruition was when Christ came and began to teach, and his dying was the beginning of the twelve tribes being gathered back together. That is what his death was about: he was sent by his Father to gather the flock of Jacob into one fold.

precepts.text: If a man walking in the spirit and falsehood do lie, saying, I will prophesy unto thee of wine: the wine he transgresses by is the falsehood and the lying. Esau gave you Protestant, Mormon, Seventh-day Adventist, Jehovah's Witness, Pentecostal, Freemasonry, Rosicrucian: lies. Every institute of doctrine he put on this earth takes you away from God.
precepts.point: Behold, his soul which is lifted up is not upright in him: something is wrong with that man; the Most High created him that way.

note.label: I Come In Peace

precepts.why:
Habakkuk says of the proud man, “because he transgresseth by wine”. What is the wine he transgresses by? Micah gives the precept: “If a man walking in the spirit and falsehood do lie, saying, I will prophesy unto thee of wine and of strong drink; he shall even be the prophet of this people.”

The wine is the falsehood and the lying. Esau is a liar. He gave you Protestant: lies. Mormon: lies. Seventh-day Adventists, Jehovah's Witnesses, Pentecostal: lies. Freemasonry, Rosicrucian, Thelema: lies. Every institute of doctrine he put on this earth for you to follow and worship is a lie, and all they do is take you away from God.

That wine is how he rules. He “neither keepeth at home”: the US controls about 850 military bases in more than 90 countries, and there are more churches than military bases. The real way to control us is through Christianity, because we are more obedient to Christianity than to his military. And the church convinces you it is okay to be broke, okay to be poor and hurt, okay for your country to lie desolate while another man eats your riches: just pray to Jesus and you will be all right.

No, it is not okay. The earth belongs to us and it is going to come back to us. The just shall live by his faith, not by the wine of the prophet of lies.

precepts.text: If a man walking in the spirit and falsehood do lie, saying I will prophesy unto thee of wine and strong drink, he shall even be the prophet of this people. Wine is the metaphor for the spirit of falsehood and lies.
precepts.point: When thou shalt cease to spoil, thou shalt be spoiled, and when thou makest an end to deal treacherously, they shall deal treacherously with thee. God will let the nations rise up.

note.label: Hope Amid Destruction

precepts.why:
“If a man walking in the spirit and falsehood do lie, saying, I will prophesy unto thee of wine and of strong drink; he shall even be the prophet of this people.” This defines the wine of Habakkuk 2:5. Wine is a metaphor for the spirit of falsehood and lies.

So when Habakkuk says the spoiler “transgresseth by wine”, it is not speaking of a drunkard. This white man transgresses by his falsehoods: his philosophies, his political policies, his religions. That is the wine he prophesies, and he makes himself the prophet of the people with it.

That is the one in Isaiah 33:1 that spoils and deals treacherously: proud, in everybody's business, setting up his democracy wherever he goes. Isaiah 33:1 says woe to him, because when he ceases to spoil, he shall be spoiled.

precepts.text: Arise ye, and depart; for this is not your rest: because it is polluted, it shall destroy you.
precepts.point: Seeking his face means seeing in Revelation 1:14 that Christ looks like his people. The house, the car and the barbecue are Esau's way of life.

note.label: Latinos For Trump: Alien Vs. Predator

precepts.why:
“in their affliction they will seek me early.” Why do we have to get deported? So that we seek God early. A lot of our people think this is the American dream, this is what life is about: get a house, get a car, barbecue on the weekend, watch sports, send your kids to college. No, that is Esau's way of life. This is death, this is oppression, and the Most High has to afflict us to remind us that this is not our rest.

Micah says it: “Arise ye, and depart”. Separate yourself from these heathen nations, these strangers, the real aliens. “for this is not your rest”. You were not brought here on slave ships to be comfortable, to assimilate, or to be friends with these heathen nations. You see the betrayal time and time again when you make a league with the strangers. “Our necks are under persecution: we labour, and have no rest”: we work and we have to watch our backs for ICE agents who come to our places of business and our homes, arrest us and kidnap our children.

“because it is polluted”: wicked, evil, deceptive. Witchcraft is in this place, so bad that it has you bleaching your skin, blonding your hair, putting in contacts, starving yourself. “it shall destroy you”: it destroyed Sammy Sosa, Serena Williams, Lil' Kim. Those are the celebrities Esau upholds so our people look up to them and want to be like them. It is witchcraft to make a black man hate himself so much that he destroys his own face.

“even with a sore destruction.” Destruction is coming to this place; this kingdom is not going to last forever. We are in the last days, so we have to get our minds right and our spirits right. There is much work to be done, especially for you so-called Latinos: Judah has shown us the way, and now it is our turn. When you see a head of state like Nicolás Maduro kidnapped and his country's resources stolen, that is for you to wake up. Seek his face, and see in the scriptures that he looks just like us.

precepts.text: Woe to them that devise iniquity; when the morning is light, they practise it, because it is in the power of their hand.
precepts.point: They covet fields and take them by violence; they oppress a man and his house, even a man and his heritage.

note.label: Raising Cain: The Son of Perdition, Merchants, and Captive Nations

precepts.why:
“Shall the throne of iniquity have fellowship with thee, which frameth mischief by a law?” They do not abandon the law; they weaponise it. They wrote the laws, so they know how to get around them. The most powerful pen in the world, with a stack of bills beside it, is the president of the United States, and every nation bends the knee. Violence gets reframed legally in their decrees and doctrines: kidnapping becomes a law enforcement operation, sanctions become international order, theft becomes stabilising the region. When he promised to lock up the criminal illegal immigrants, you thought thieves and murderers; but by their law, anyone here without papers is a criminal. That is framing mischief by a law.

Micah shows how they work: “Woe to them that devise iniquity, and work evil upon their beds! when the morning is light, they practise it, because it is in the power of their hand.” When the morning is light means in broad daylight, because they can frame it by law, and he says his own morality is the only limit. It is in the power of their hand because they are after the working of Satan, given authority to set kings up and take them down.

“And they covet fields, and take them by violence; and houses, and take them away: so they oppress a man and his house, even a man and his heritage.” It is not just the resources; they want the identity too. Venezuela's vice president said the country was attacked by Zionists seeking to enslave the nation. Netanyahu, whom he calls his boss, visited before the attack. Machado, who won the Nobel Peace Prize and then gave it to Trump, promised to open the oil to their companies and move Venezuela's embassy to Jerusalem, because everybody has to bow the knee to the impostors.

Maduro said he is a Jew in his blood, from the twelve tribes, and that the man over there is not a real Jew. That is the heritage they are after. The ADL says it has analysts monitoring 24 hours a day and trains law enforcement, and in Patagonia Israeli tourists were caught setting fires in a protected preserve they cannot buy unless it is damaged. Their eye is on the land and on the lost tribes. They practise it in the light, because it is in the power of their hand.

precepts.text: Never trust thine enemy, for like as iron rusteth, so is his wickedness.
precepts.point: They covet fields and take them by violence, as with the oil of Nigeria and Venezuela and the land taken from Black towns in the South.

note.label: Political Power Under Darkness

precepts.why:
They tell you plainly they are the evil seed, and you can believe them if you want to, but they ain't fooling us. God said: “Never trust thine enemy: for like as iron rusteth, so is his wickedness.” Never trust our enemies.

Then Micah shows the enemy at work: “Woe to them that devise iniquity, and work evil upon their beds!” That is Esau. In his sleep he is thinking, when I wake up, what type of evil am I going to do? “when the morning is light, they practise it”: he gets up and practises the same evil he was thinking of the night before, “because it is in the power of their hand.”

Picture it: we are going to steal the oil in Nigeria; let's say we are going in to defend the Christians. Nigeria is a black country, and if white men go in, they will be called racist. So find me a dumb black woman, the biggest hoe, one with millions of followers that dumb black people will believe, like Nicki Minaj, and put her up front. That is devising iniquity on the bed and practising it in the morning.

His wickedness rusts through everything like iron rusts. So never trust him when he says he is defending you, and never trust the peace he talks about.

precepts.text: He hath oppressed the poor and violently taken away an house which he builded not.
precepts.point: They covet fields and take them by violence, as with the oil of Nigeria and Venezuela and the land taken from Black towns in the South.

note.label: Political Power Under Darkness

precepts.why:
Micah says, “And they covet fields, and take them by violence; and houses, and take them away: so they oppress a man and his house, even a man and his heritage.” They covet the oil in Nigeria and Venezuela, the diamonds and copper in all the African countries, and take them by violence. America was built by violence: this is stolen land, and millions of indigenous people died for it. After they killed, murdered and raped, they built churches and said, God so loved the world.

Job describes the same man: “Because he hath oppressed and hath forsaken the poor; because he hath violently taken away an house which he builded not”. Esau has oppressed, and we are the poor.

He violently took away houses he did not build. In the South, in Georgia, they drove whole black communities out of places like Lake Lanier and Forsyth and took the houses and businesses they never worked for, and they are still finding ways to take land that has been in black families for a century. When Esau came into Africa, King Leopold killed millions of our people, and the beauty of Europe was paid for with that. It is still happening: the wars in Sudan and the Congo, the minerals in the iPhone in your hand. He throws the rock and hides his hand, then says, black people killing black people. But black people don't make the weapons.

The dumb Christian says it was a long time ago. But every September 11 they want a moment of silence. It is not a long time ago; he is still violently taking away houses he builded not.

precepts.text: All this power will I give thee, for that is delivered unto me.
precepts.point: They covet fields and take them by violence, and oppress a man and his house.

note.label: Babylon Speaks Plainly: Venezuela and the Real WMD

precepts.why:
“Woe to them that devise iniquity, and work evil upon their beds! when the morning is light, they practise it, because it is in the power of their hand.” Upon their beds means they are insulated from consequence; they know nobody can touch them, like Trump saying in his first term he could shoot somebody on Fifth Avenue and nobody would do anything. When the morning is light, they do it through institutions, laws and bills stacked higher than a ream of paper, with billions in them for Israel and Ukraine. They are vessels of wrath fitted for destruction, and that is our hope: all that wrath will be paid back to them double.

Why is it in the power of their hand? Luke shows who gave it. After showing Christ all the kingdoms, “the devil said unto him, All this power will I give thee, and the glory of them: for that is delivered unto me; and to whomsoever I will I give it.”

To whomsoever I will, I give it. So who gave them their power? Satan. And who are the ministers of Satan? Babylon the great, Esau: what the world ignorantly calls the white man.

That is why they covet fields, oil fields, iron ore fields, rare earth fields, agricultural fields, and take them by violence, as with Venezuela. The power in their hand was delivered to them by the devil.

precepts.text: The earth is given into the hand of the wicked.
precepts.point: They covet fields and take them by violence, and oppress a man and his house.

note.label: Babylon Speaks Plainly: Venezuela and the Real WMD

precepts.why:
It is given into his hand to do these things. Job says it: “The earth is given into the hand of the wicked: he covereth the faces of the judges thereof; if not, where, and who is he?” It goes with Micah 2 and with Luke 4:6.

He covers the faces of the judges: the real judges, which are the Israelites. And “if not, where, and who is he?” If it is not given to him, then who is he? If it is not this man, who is it?

Look at their conferences: the United Nations, the G8, the economic forums, diverse nations in a room together and Israel not represented. When these prophecies were revealed to our forefathers, they were seeing visuals of things like this: the halls and conference centers of all the nations taking crafty counsel together about world domination.

It reinforces even more that only Christ can save us from this. There is no way to play in their sandbox, in their politics. No leader will rise up and combat what they have done, because the earth has been given into the hand of the wicked.

precepts.text: The throne of iniquity, which frameth mischief by a law.
precepts.point: They covet fields and take them by violence, and oppress a man and his house.

note.label: Babylon Speaks Plainly: Venezuela and the Real WMD

precepts.why:
When the morning is light they practise it, and they do it through law. “Shall the throne of iniquity have fellowship with thee, which frameth mischief by a law?”

That is how the whole system was designed. The Constitution was not framed for us; we were three-fifths of a man. It was based on Roman and Greek democracy, which you read of in the Maccabees, and even then we were not part of it. It was framed to keep them in power. The Supreme Court interprets Esau's constitution, and it is all set up with words that frame mischief to benefit them. Our salvation is not in that.

Look at it now: the Supreme Court, 6 to 3, on its shadow docket, behind closed doors, gave ICE the green light to stop and detain people based on appearance, language, accent or workplace. That is racial profiling blessed by law, and it targets the northern kingdom. So if you are a citizen and you fit the profile, carry your passport or a passport card.

Sanctions, asset seizures, blockades: all of that is violence too, economic violence. When you oppress a man and his house and his heritage, whether you take him by the neck or frame a law, it is still violence. If what they want is not legal, they find a way to weaponize the legal system. That is the throne of iniquity.

precepts.text: Arise ye, and depart, for this is not your rest; it is polluted, it shall destroy you with a sore destruction.
precepts.point: Arise ye and depart does not mean to leave physically; it means come up out of the ways of this place, because it is polluted. Israel waits for the time when the third part has repented, the hundred forty and four thousand are sealed, and Christ returns to take his people out of this place and set them back in their own land.

note.label: Deuteronomy 12: The Place Where the Lord Puts His Name

precepts.why:
“Arise ye, and depart; for this is not your rest: because it is polluted, it shall destroy you, even with a sore destruction.” Moses told Israel “ye are not as yet come to the rest and to the inheritance”: the rest is when the Lord gives “rest from all your enemies round about, so that ye dwell in safety”. Micah says the same of where Israel is now, and this is why the scripture is pulled out on the street: this is not our rest. Israel today dwells among its enemies and serves them for food, shelter, and clothing, as Deuteronomy 28 declares. That is not rest from all your enemies round about.

Arise ye and depart does not mean to leave physically. It means come up out of the ways of this place, because it is polluted, and it shall destroy you with a sore destruction. Israel waits for the time when the third part has repented, the hundred forty and four thousand are sealed, and Christ returns to take his people out of this place and set them back in their own land. Then comes the rest and the inheritance which the Lord giveth.

precepts.text: The Most High's own people rise up as an enemy; the enemies Christ said to forgive are the enemies of our people.
precepts.point: Now he asks Absalom to let him choose out twelve thousand men to pursue David that same night while David was weary and weak handed, to smite the king only and bring back all the people. He wanted the victory and the bragging rights of being the one who killed King David.

note.label: 2 Samuel 17: The Counsel of the Lord Shall Stand

precepts.why:
“Even of late my people is risen up as an enemy: ye pull off the robe with the garment from them that pass by securely as men averse from war.”

The Most High’s own people rise up as an enemy. Ahithophel was David’s own counselor, working betrayal from inside the gates of Israel, and here he asks to pursue David that same night and smite the king only.

The enemies Christ said to forgive are the enemies of our people.

precepts.text: They covet fields and take them by violence, and houses and take them away; they oppress a man, his house, his heritage, changing your name.
precepts.point: They drive away the ass of the fatherless and take the widow's ox for a pledge. They turn the needy out of the way, and the poor of the earth hide themselves together.

note.label: Job 24: The Crimes of the Oppressor

precepts.why:
“And they covet fields, and take them by violence; and houses, and take them away: so they oppress a man and his house, even a man and his heritage.” That is Job's “they violently take away flocks” in Micah's words: coveting fields and taking them by violence, taking houses away, oppressing a man, his house and his heritage.

Taking a man's heritage is changing your name. They move into your land, name it after themselves and take away who you are. That is what removing the landmarks comes to.

precepts.text: Woe to them that devise iniquity and work evil upon their beds, and when the morning is light they practice it, because it is in the power of their hand.
precepts.point: The wickedness of this nation gets worse and worse. People who have changed what the Most High made them are now over the educational system, showing children sexual things they are not even supposed to know exist. Yet those same children they say are not fit to choose which parent they want to be with; they put up laws and red tape to keep a child from the parent they want to be around.

note.label: Psalm 36: The Transgression of the Wicked

precepts.why:
“He deviseth mischief upon his bed; he setteth himself in a way that is not good; he abhorreth not evil.” Micah pronounces the judgment on it: “Woe to them that devise iniquity, and work evil upon their beds! when the morning is light, they practise it, because it is in the power of their hand.” They plan it at night and carry it out in the morning, because right now the power is in their hand.

While we are sleeping, they are up thinking how to take us down, whether it be our own people or the wicked Esau of the other nations. While we do the work and study the word, they are typing on Facebook figuring out how to take us down. That is why when Christ said we would be hated of all nations, he meant all nations, including our own nation.

precepts.text: They covet fields and take them by violence, and houses, and take them away, oppressing a man and his heritage.
precepts.point: The kingdom of heaven, the Israelites, suffered violence and the violent took it by force; Israel was taken out of the land by violence and Jerusalem is trodden down of the Gentiles until their time is fulfilled.

note.label: Psalm 48: Zion the Joy of the Whole Earth

precepts.why:
“Beautiful for situation, the joy of the whole earth, is mount Zion, on the sides of the north, the city of the great King.” Zion is the most sought after place on the earth, and that is why Esau always coveted the land: “And they covet fields, and take them by violence; and houses, and take them away: so they oppress a man and his house, even a man and his heritage.”

They covet fields and take them by violence, and houses, and take them away, oppressing a man and his heritage. Esau coveted Zion and told Babylon to raze it even to the foundation. The land was our heritage, and it was taken by violence.

precepts.text: My people is risen up as an enemy, pulling off the robe and garment from them that pass by, like stealing a man's starter jacket or gym shoes.
precepts.point: Day and night they go about seeking violence; wickedness is in the midst and deceit and guile depart not from her streets.

note.label: Psalm 55: Cast Thy Burden Upon the Lord

precepts.why:
“Destroy, O Lord, and divide their tongues: for I have seen violence and strife in the city.” This is us being cursed in the city. “Even of late my people is risen up as an enemy: ye pull off the robe with the garment from them that pass by securely as men averse from war.” The Most High's own people are risen up as an enemy, pulling off the robe and garment from them that pass by, like stealing a man's starter jacket or his gym shoes.

You want to hasten your escape because you open the doors and go out into the world to work, shop or school, and there is all this strife among our people. Moses dealt with the same thing when he left Pharaoh's house and found two men fighting.

precepts.text: Arise and depart, for this is not your rest, because it is polluted and shall destroy you with a sore destruction, yet some of our people love this place and love the oppression.
precepts.point: I am for peace, but when I speak, they are for war. With his smooth policies, politics, religion, and lies our people believe him, but war is in his mind, designed to destroy us secretly, the same as was done to the Indians. We are to live peaceably with all men if possible and rely on the law of this Bible.

note.label: Psalm 120: In My Distress I Cried Unto the Lord

precepts.why:
“Arise ye, and depart; for this is not your rest: because it is polluted, it shall destroy you, even with a sore destruction.” Dwelling with him that hateth peace is not our rest. This place is polluted and it shall destroy us with a sore destruction, so we are told to arise and depart.

Yet some of our people love this place and love the oppression, sojourning in Mesech and the tents of Kedar as if it were home.

precepts.text: The evil man is the one who devises iniquity and works evil upon his bed; this points to Esau.
precepts.point: The key points show us who he is talking about: one who imagines mischief in his heart, who is continually gathered together for war, whose tongue is sharpened like a serpent with adder's poison under his lips.

note.label: Psalm 140: Deliver Me From the Evil Man

precepts.why: “Deliver me, O Lord, from the evil man”. David is not talking about everyone who commits wickedness but a particular person, and the key points show who: one “Which imagine mischiefs in their heart”. “Woe to them that devise iniquity, and work evil upon their beds! when the morning is light, they practise it, because it is in the power of their hand.” The evil man is the one who devises iniquity and works evil upon his bed, and this points to Esau.

precepts.text: A man walking in falsehood who prophesies of wine and strong drink is the prophet this people want; the people err in lies and philosophies like Christianity and politricks.
precepts.point: The priests and prophets err through wine and strong drink and are out of the way; they are not drunk on the law of God but on the philosophies of men, and today this is the pastors and the politicians who err with lies and philosophy and love it. Their tables are full of vomit, so all the religions today are full of vomit and there is no place clean.

note.label: Isaiah 28: Woe to the Drunkards of Ephraim and Precept Upon Precept

precepts.why:
“the priest and the prophet have erred through strong drink, they are swallowed up of wine, they are out of the way through strong drink; they err in vision, they stumble in judgment.” They are not drunk on the law of God but on the philosophies of men. Micah shows who such a prophet is: “If a man walking in the spirit and falsehood do lie, saying, I will prophesy unto thee of wine and of strong drink; he shall even be the prophet of this people.”

A man walking in falsehood who prophesies of wine and strong drink is the prophet this people want. Today this is the pastors and the politicians who err with lies and philosophy and love it; the people err in lies and philosophies like Christianity and politricks. “For all tables are full of vomit and filthiness, so that there is no place clean”: all the religions today are full of vomit, and there is no place clean. In that day the Lord of hosts is the crown of glory only to the residue of His people, the remnant that escapes the judgment.

note.label: Bishop Nathanyel | Revelation 6 The 4 Horsemen

precepts.why: “Woe to them that devise iniquity, and work evil upon their beds! when the morning is light, they practise it, because it is in the power of their hand.” Why is it in the power of their hand? Because that was the blessing given unto them, by thy sword shalt thou live. “And they covet fields,” They covet fields, “and take them by violence;” They take them by violence. “and houses, and take them away: so they oppress a man and his house, even a man and his heritage.” So they oppress a man and his house.

note.label: Bishop Nathanyel | Revelation 6 The 4 Horsemen

precepts.why: How do we know the wine in Habakkuk 2:5 is philosophy? Somebody in the back is asking; there might be an Israelite camp that says wine means alcohol and tobacco, something stupid like that. “If a man walking in the spirit and falsehood do lie, saying, I will prophesy unto thee of wine and of strong drink;” You are walking in the spirit and falsehood and lie, saying I will prophesy unto thee of wine. So that wine makes reference to lying, falsehood; that is what it is talking about. “he shall even be the prophet of this people.” So the wine in Habakkuk 2 is going into lies, philosophies, policies.

note.label: Bishop Nathanyel | Revelation 18: Babylon Is Fallen

precepts.why: Where the wine is explained: “If a man walking in the spirit and falsehood do lie, saying, I will prophesy unto thee of wine and of strong drink; he shall even be the prophet of this people.” The word wine makes reference to lies, falsehood.

note.label: Bishop Nathanyel | Breakdown Of Revelation 16

precepts.why: How the Bible uses the word wine: “If a man walking in the spirit and falsehood do lie, saying, I will prophesy unto thee of wine and of strong drink; he shall even be the prophet of this people.” Wine and strong drink represent lies, falsehood. God uses the term wine, metaphorically, to symbolize lies.

note.label: Bishop Nathanyel | Revelation 17 WW3: The EU Vs. America

precepts.why: “If a man walking in the spirit and falsehood do lie, saying, I will prophesy unto thee of wine and of strong drink”: here the prophet Micah is comparing wine to falsehood and strong drink. So when we go back to Jeremiah 51:7, her wine represents falsehood and lies.

note.label: Bishop Nathanyel | Revelation 14 Part 2

precepts.why: To explain wine: “If a man walking in the spirit and falsehood do lie, saying, I will prophesy unto thee of wine”. Wine is a similitude, a metaphor for lies, for falsehood. This is where the spirit of discernment comes in: in some scriptures wine means literal wine, and in others, like the book of Revelation, it is a similitude for lies.
